scope: Duel game content and rules; original printings remain available for non-Duel formats

rules.opening_shop: Initial six: cost 5 or less, with reviewed Comet exception. Later refills unrestricted. Skipped cards retained and shuffled privately.
rules.champion_combat: Duel attacks resolve during the active turn, pay exact remaining effective defense, and immediately recalculate target restrictions. Player damage remains at turn end.
rules.zetta: Guards protect their owner and non-guards; guards remain targetable when multiple guards are present. Direct destruction keeps its existing behavior.
rules.testudo: Each actual card play with positive live shield grants current champions +1 defense per Testudo until owner next turn. Grants survive Testudo removal; recipients lose grants when leaving play.
rules.dna: Pay 4 gems/exhaust; next actual paid or free recruit this turn, including relic recruit or normally purchased Comet, creates one copy straight into discard. No recursive recruit trigger. Unused copy expires at cleanup.
rules.crown_order: Mastery, health, draw, then M20 Unify check.

ai.compatibility: Frozen original card slots; errata map to replaced identities; new cards use explicit existing-card embeddings. Actual numeric properties, legal actions, public inventory and search simulation use patched rules.

validation.unity_faces: Four new faces have rendered art and text; champion live defense and tint reset pass.
validation.unity_playmode: Both profiles load. In each, board pointer click kills an enemy Zetta immediately, pays 7 power including +2 temporary defense, and moves card to discard.
validation.content_audit: 22 reviewed card records match exported values. 202 unique French card entries; 19 bilingual before/after records.
validation.review_page: Live page: 25 comparisons and patch links, before/after labels, resolved DNA/Testudo/combat notes; 390px mobile layout without horizontal overflow; zero JavaScript errors. Saved reviews and user drafts unchanged.
